name: entity_type
description: The kind of entity the detection is about: 'video' or 'channel'.

name: entity_id
description: The YouTube video ID or channel ID.

name: modality
description: What the detection was made in: 'title', 'description' or 'tags' for keyword matches; 'thumbnail' or 'thumbnail_and_metadata' for Gemini evaluations.

name: source
description: Where the signal came from. Currently always 'first_party'.

name: detector
description: The detector that produced the row: 'keyword_match' or 'gemini_thumbnail_metadata_eval'.

name: detector_version
description: Hand-maintained version of the detector's rules or prompt, bumped whenever they change, so rows written under different rules can be told apart after the fact.

name: taxonomy
description: The classification namespace the label belongs to: 'advertiser_blocklist.keyword' for keyword matches; 'age_eval.minor_presence', 'content_eval.<category>' or 'audit.evaluated' for Gemini evaluations. Consumers filter on this rather than on detector identity.

name: label
description: For keyword matches, the matched keyword in its normalised (trimmed, lowercased) form. For Gemini evaluations, the category name, 'minor_presence', or 'evaluated'.

name: score
description: Detector confidence. NULL for the keyword detector, which is deterministic. For Gemini evaluations: the category score from 0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 or 0.0 for minor_presence; always 0.0 for the audit.evaluated row.

name: evidence
description: Detector-specific supporting detail. Unused by the keyword detector. For Gemini evaluations: the model and Gemini's reasoning, plus the people seen and their estimated ages for minor_presence; on the audit.evaluated row, whether the evaluation succeeded.

name: first_detected_at
description: When this detection was first observed. Preserved across merges.

name: last_detected_at
description: When this detection was most recently observed.

name: expires_at
description: When the detection should stop being treated as current. Unused by the current detectors.

name: retracted_at
description: When the detection was withdrawn, e.g. because its keyword left the sheet. Rows are retracted rather than deleted so history survives. The Gemini evaluator does not retract rows: a new evaluation of a video overwrites its previous one.
